hotel_name: Hotel Dream Connect – Comfy Rooms, Gurgaon

positive_snippets: Umm. Good  experience while staying there even the food is upto expectations. Definitely deserve 5 star and good review. Keep it up dream connect and its team 👍

Great short stay!
Had a quick stay here and it was surprisingly smooth. The room was clean, comfy, and exactly what I needed after a long day. Staff handled everything quickly and politely, and the check-in/check-out was super easy. For a short visit, this place honestly delivers more than expected. Would definitely come back.
